instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Notary and property conveyancing practice processing residential and commercial property transactions. Handling approximately 800 transactions per year. Paper-intensive process with complex multi-party coordination. Evaluating digital deed registration integration and automated document assembly from structured client data. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 5 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

opportunities.title: Build Low-Code Process Automation Bridge for Core Transactions
opportunities.rationale: The core bottleneck is manual data transfer and process gaps between existing systems. By implementing low-code/no-code automation bridges, Strato can achieve significant throughput gains (targeting the 20% goal) without massive overhauls or increasing headcount. This leverages existing developer skills while standardizing critical transaction workflows.

first_actions: Identify 3 most time-consuming manual handoffs in property conveyancing.
Document current state (As-Is) processes with detailed data fields and decision points.
Run a pilot automation loop for the least complex, highest volume transaction type.
resources_needed: Dedicated 20% time allocation from generalist developers
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual touchpoints per transaction cycle (Target: >30%)
milestones: Completion of As-Is process documentation for 2 key workflows.
Successful end-to-end test run of automated bridge (UAT).
Deployment and measurement of ROI on the first fully automated workflow.

opportunities.title: Proof of Concept for Structured Digital Deed Registration Intake
opportunities.rationale: Given the strategic goal and high potential revenue impact, direct integration with digital registries is essential. A PoC must focus only on structured data inputs (e.g., client identity, property details) to minimize initial complexity and risk. This transforms a paper-intensive process into a verifiable digital stream.

first_actions: Engage subject matter experts (SMEs) from the registry/legal side to map required structured data schema.
Build a secure, temporary intake form/portal for clients/internal staff capturing only structured data points.
Prototype the API connection and validation logic for submission.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful, validated digital submission of 10 test transactions to the target system.
milestones: Completion of data schema mapping and required legal sign-off.
Development of secure front-end intake interface (PoC).
Demonstration of successful end-to-end PoC submission.

next_steps.action: Conduct a mandated cross-functional process mapping workshop to standardize inputs and data flows across all departments, focusing on low variability tasks.

Develop a formalized 'Innovation Time Budget' policy that allocates dedicated development hours for R&D (e.g., 1 day/week) to prevent innovation from being perpetually deferred by urgent operational maintenance.
Identify and benchmark external low-code/BPM solutions to rapidly assess if internal development is the most cost-effective path for process automation.

key_weaknesses: Process documentation and standardization are immature, limiting systemic improvements.
Lack of dedicated R&D bandwidth due to generalist developer burnout on maintenance/support.
Culture clash post-merger integration still requires active mediation to build trust between legacy and new teams.

improvements: Business case approved for full IoT rollout, signaling increased operational investment capacity.
Team size increase (to 5 members) provides more manpower for process execution.
Successfully completed initial phase of standardization efforts (Step 1).
persistent_gaps: Process mapping is still tactical rather than comprehensive (lack of standardized data flow architecture).
The current developer capacity is insufficient to manage both maintenance and strategic innovation simultaneously.
achieved_milestones: IoT pilot success, validating ability to analyze operational efficiency.
Approval of full fleet rollout for equipment monitoring.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant organizational scaling occurred (team doubled) and initial process improvements were executed. The focus has sharpened from general capacity building to concrete automation opportunities targeting throughput increase.
